tools.description: Search the marketplace catalog of the configured Allowit server for paid services. Free. Listed prices are indicative; the seller states the price when called.

all_rails.description: Include entries of every rail, not only of the selected one

query.description: What the service should do. Empty lists the catalog.

tools.name: marketplace_search

tools.description: Read one marketplace catalog entry by its id: resource URL, methods and indicative terms. Free.
tools.name: marketplace_show

tools.description: Call a paid service by catalog entry id or URL. If the seller asks for payment, pay at most max_price within the wallet policy and return the resource. A policy denial is an error that names the rule.

max_price.description: The most that this call may pay. A higher price is refused and nothing is paid.

unit.description: The asset code of the amount

request_id.description: The request ID of the payment. Repeat it to retry: the same ID never pays twice.

target.description: A catalog entry id or an http(s) URL

tools.name: call

tools.description: Request an http(s) URL. On HTTP 402, pay at most max_price within the wallet policy and request it once more with the proof of payment.

max_price.description: The most that this call may pay. A higher price is refused and nothing is paid.

unit.description: The asset code of the amount

request_id.description: The request ID of the payment. Repeat it to retry: the same ID never pays twice.

tools.name: http

tools.description: Read the receipt of one request by its ID: transaction, ledger, fee, counted fee and limits. Pays nothing.
tools.name: status

tools.description: Show the selected wallet: its kind, policy params and spending limits. Changes nothing.
tools.name: wallet_show
